name: veo-match-analytics
description: Open Veo match analysis pages, extract rendered team, player, and event analytics, and save confirmed match data, the official score, and athlete-linked player statistics to Supabase.

interface.shortDescription: Save Veo match and linked player analytics
interface.longDescription: Open a Veo match analysis URL in the browser, pause for sign-in when required, separately extract rendered team statistics, player statistics, and the observed XHR/fetch event feed, confirm the ClubATX fixture, team mapping, official score, and current lineup athlete links, then persist and verify the match payload, score, and athlete-linked player rows in Supabase.
defaultPrompt: Extract and save analytics from this Veo match URL
